bio: Growing up, Remile didn’t care much about his talent for magic – he grew up dealing with street gangs, and magic was less help than quick wits and fast feet. But it was the magic that saved him in the end: a Magi found him in trouble, and got him into the Academy. Now, it’s the gangs’ turn to run.
